snippet.title: Watch_Dogs - DedSec Edition_Unboxing [UK]
snippet.description:
Preorder here: http://www.watchdogs.com/preorder 
Join us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/watchdogsgame 
    The DedSec Edition is Watch_Dogs' premium Collector Edition, ideal to immerse yourself in the world of Watch_Dogs. 

Discover now the high-end content exclusively created to let you live an extended Watch_Dogs' experience!
